entities.name: night sky

entities.name: distant dark mountain ridge
entities.identification: The gently undulating outline of a dark mountain behind the buildings, with a small number of warm-colored bright points scattered nearby.

entities.name: metal guardrail of the elevated roadway
entities.identification: Gray thin-rod railings extending along both edges of the elevated roadway deck, with parallel horizontal rails and spaced vertical posts.
